text:
liz_support: Escalation from ACME — their JSON schema validation started failing after yesterday's model upgrade to rwd-3.1. They get parsing errors and broken fields. Request id 01FZ9ABCDX.

liz_support: Customer repro (curl):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3.1","mode":"json","prompt":"Generate user object","max_tokens":200}'
```

liz_support: Their response snippet: 
```json
{"id":"user_123","name":"O\"Connor","email":null}
```

liz_support: Previously the model either returned "email":"" or omitted the key; now it returns null which fails their strict validator. Also note extra backslash before quote in name.

anya_ml: looking into model-side changes. Quick hypothesis: rwd-3.1 changed serialization behavior (native nulls) and we turned on an extra escaping sanitizer. That combo + streaming chunking might be corrupting strings.

david_runtime: I can repro locally if stream=true. When a chunk boundary slices inside a quoted string the reassembly ends up with an extra backslash. Minimal repro below.

david_runtime: repro (py):
```python
resp = client.generate(model="rwd-3.1", mode="json", prompt="...", stream=True)
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk.text)
```

kevin_sre: logs for request_id 01FZ9ABCDX show 2026-03-15T18:24:12Z and canary instance group rg-canary-12.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout rwd-3.1 -> 5% completed at 2026-03-15T17:50:00Z :robot_face:

anya_ml: root cause narrowed: serializer now emits JSON fragments with escaping to prevent injection, then the streaming writer re-escapes fragments when concatenating. Also we now map absent-string->null for tokens that resolved to none. Downstream strict schemas break on null.

david_runtime: short-term workaround: set stream=false or use model variant rwd-3.1-safe (disables aggressive escaping). For affected customers we can pin them to rwd-3.0.

kevin_sre: I'll pin ACME org acme-77 to rwd-3.0 and reduce canary to 2% while we patch. Creating ticket INF-4821 to track the hotfix and rollback plan.

liz_support: Customer asked for ETA — can we get a rollback now? They need immediate resolution for validation in production.

david_runtime: Patch to streaming serializer to avoid double-escaping: estimated 4h dev + 1h canary deploy. If they need now, pinning is fastest.

kevin_sre: ACME is pinned to rwd-3.0 (confirmed in control plane). Notified them that pin is live.

liz_support: ACME confirmed tests pass with pinned model. They asked to be notified when 3.1 streaming fix is deployed.

deploy-bot: Hotfix branch created: rwd-3.1-fix/escape-stream. CI build 5421 queued.

anya_ml: I'll own the fix & verify: ensure streaming fragments use a non-reentrant serializer and preserve non-string empty values as empty strings when configured.

liz_support: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with ACME and close after hotfix deploy + validation. :thumbsup:
